items.prompt: Buy 2 shares at 10.10, then sell 2 at 9.95, with no fees. What line is returned?

options.why: The sale price is lower, so the result is a loss.
That is the loss on one share, not both shares.
Negative floor-division pieces do not give the intended decimal magnitude.
Two shares each lose 0.15, for a total loss 0.30.
